scenarios.name: A stalled summary translation stops promising progress
scenarios.given: a completed English summary and a selected Chinese target with a nonresponding on-device readiness or translation service
scenarios.then: the original remains unchanged, a timeout explanation replaces progress, duplicate requests are refused, and retry becomes possible only after the old native work returns without publishing stale text

scenarios.name: Cancel ends visible progress before an uncooperative service returns
scenarios.given: summary translation is in progress and its on-device service ignores task cancellation
scenarios.when: the user cancels, changes the target, or opens another conversation
scenarios.then: old progress ends immediately, the original stays authoritative, a second native job cannot start until the old one exits, and late old text is never shown

scenarios.name: Successful translation is not invalidated by an old deadline
scenarios.given: an installed language pair returns before its deadline
scenarios.when: the summary finishes translating and the former deadline passes
scenarios.then: the translated summary and original remain available with no false timeout or additional request

scenarios.name: An obsolete paragraph deadline cannot stop newer progress
scenarios.given: one translated paragraph has completed and its cancelled timer is already ready to resume while the next paragraph is still translating
scenarios.then: the current paragraph continues without a false timeout and the complete translation remains paired with the original
